changelog: - **Large spreadsheet imports refresh and export without freezing.** With tables near the 20,000-row limit, refreshing an imported table or exporting its change proposal looked rows and nodes up one by one, so the work grew with the square of the table size: measured on the model functions alone (not in a browser), a refresh took up to about 11 seconds and the change-proposal export up to about 39 seconds. Those look-ups are now indexed once per operation; the same measurement is now under a fifth of a second for a refresh and under 40 milliseconds for the export, with identical results. How much faster the screen responds in a browser was not measured.
